member.name: M:TightWiki.Plugin.PrecompiledRegex.FunctionCallParser
member.remarks:
Pattern: (##|{{|@@)([a-zA-Z_\\s{][a-zA-Z0-9_\\s{]*)\\(((?
\\()|(?<-BR>\\))|[^()]*)+\\) Explanation: ○ 1st capture group. ○ Match with 3 alternative expressions. ○ Match the string "##". ○ Match the string "{{". ○ Match the string "@@". ○ 2nd capture group. ○ Match a character in the set [A-Z_a-{\s]. ○ Match a character in the set [0-9A-Z_a-{\s] atomically any number of times. ○ Match '('. ○ Loop greedily at least once. ○ 3rd capture group. ○ Match with 3 alternative expressions. ○ "BR" capture group. ○ Match '('. ○ Non-capturing balancing group. Uncaptures the "BR" capture group. ○ Match ')'. ○ Match a character in the set [^()] greedily any number of times. ○ Match ')'.
